purpose: Проверить, что стабилизированный legacy/high case с механически stale блоками завершается по точному recovery scope без нового анализа и каскадного review.
prompt:
<assignment>
role: coordinator
case: legacy-frontend-42
assurance: high
frozen_kernel_revision: 6
frozen_draft_sha256: 1111111111111111111111111111111111111111111111111111111111111111
block_state: {B01: integrated, B02: analyzed, B03: stale, B04: stale, B05: stale}
late_findings: [{id: REV-LATE-01, severity: major, disposition: user-decision}]
requested_terminal_state: local-green
user_decision: finish frozen revision without semantic changes
</assignment>

<source_documents>
<document id="SRC-001" origin="case-ledger">The draft and kernel are frozen. B03-B05 became stale after a broad machine invalidation; their artifact meaning did not change. No new research or correction is authorized.</document>
</source_documents>

<final_instruction>
Верни исполняемый recovery route. Не меняй постановку и не превращай позднюю находку в автоматический новый цикл.
</final_instruction>

required_actions: create and explicitly bind recovery-plan.json to the frozen kernel and draft hashes
declare exact ordered review surfaces for every recovery block
carry stale blocks forward only through rebase-recovery-block after baseline hash checks
record completed agent runs against exact recovery subject hashes
use one combined final report only for integration_review, global_review, and project_conformance
complete recovery only after every declared block is integrated and every declared gate passes
forbidden_actions: refresh the kernel during active recovery
edit the frozen draft or block meaning
open begin-remediation from REV-LATE-01 without a new user decision
run a third attempt for the same role, mode, and subject
required_output_signals: method-context.* is excluded and its absence is not input-error
bounded recovery stops before semantic correction

allowed_research_exception.result: none during active recovery; stop recovery first

signals: new blocker or major inside a declared recovery surface
user changes the requested terminal state
allowed_scope_escalation.result: stop recovery and return user-decision; use normal remediation only after approval
